purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Fafi Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source arithmetic defect without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 900 DPI (page 2 of 3, the polling-station data page whose bottom row is the constituency TOTAL). The scan is skewed, so the TOTAL row band was cropped tall enough to hold the full row at every x-position, then split into left and right halves for independent close reading; all seven cells (Registered Voters, four candidates, Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots) are unambiguous. Header column order confirmed from page 1: Registered Voters | ODINGA RAILA | RUTO WILLIAM SAMOEI | WAHIGA DAVID MWAURE | WAJACKOYAH GEORGE LUCHIRI | Total Valid Votes | Rejected Ballots.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5, and cross-checked against the independent portal manifest discovery in scripts/p23/discover-iebc-form34b-manifest.py), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image at high DPI, split into left/right crops to rule out a misread. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-031-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Registered voters (27335) matches the governed P23 denominator exactly. However, the four candidate cells on the TOTAL row sum to 13847 (5403 + 8377 + 18 + 49) while the row's own printed Total Valid Votes is 13662 (delta 185). Re-read at high DPI with left/right split crops on the TOTAL row to rule out a misread; all figures are unambiguous on the source image. The candidate-cell sum (13,847) exceeds the printed Total Valid Votes (13,662) by 185. This is a genuine printed-form defect on the constituency TOTAL row itself (not a per-station transcription question, since only the aggregate row is affected), so no turnout observation is promoted from this evidence. Per form34b-extraction-contract.json (prohibited_methods bars silently correcting digits to force reconciliation), this row is recorded as verification_state=arithmetic_mismatch and not promoted.
